blocks.text: Let us get one thing straight right off the bat, my dear readers: real rock and roll never truly dies—it just waits for the right moment to remind everyone who is really in charge. On November 14, 2026, history was undeniably written in bold, black-eyeliner-stained letters at the mammoth Philippine Arena in Bulacan. Presented by PULP Live World as part of their massive Southeast Asia 2026 Tour, American rock titans My Chemical Romance—composed of frontman Gerard Way, guitarists Ray Toro and Frank Iero, and bassist Mikey Way—returned to our shores after an agonizing 18-year wait since their 2008 debut show in […]...
